FIELDS.NAME: Precision Tire and Auto Center
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Precision Tire and Auto Center, we specialize in tire sales and installation for passenger vehicles and light trucks. Our core operations include tire balancing, rotation, and repair services that adhere strictly to industry safety standards. Additionally, we provide basic automotive maintenance services such as oil changes, battery replacements, and fluid top-offs to ensure vehicle reliability. Our team comprises certified technicians who undergo regular safety training, ensuring that our practices minimize risks to both our staff and customers. We maintain a clean and organized facility, with clear separation between customer waiting areas and service bays to enhance safety. Environmental regulations are strictly followed in the handling and disposal of hazardous materials, and we offer tire storage for our customers' seasonal needs. We prioritize quality service using reputable suppliers and strive for continuous improvement in our operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a customer vehicle was damaged during a routine tire installation due to a mishap with the equipment. The total cost of damages amounted to $1,200. The claim was settled in December 2022, and all necessary safety protocols were reviewed and reinforced afterward.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Secured storage area for hazardous materials, Metal vault, Insulated and fire-rated
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and monitored surveillance system.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Our operations primarily involve tire sales and basic automotive maintenance, and we strictly adhere to environmental regulations regarding the minimal use of hazardous materials. We do not engage in storing, treating, or transporting hazardous materials beyond routine automotive fluids.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – We do not sponsor any athletic teams at Precision Tire and Auto Center. Our focus is primarily on tire sales and basic automotive maintenance services.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our Operations Manager to ensure compliance and minimize risk.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions for fraud, bribery, arson, or any arson-related crimes associated with this business or its owners.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. All insurance coverage has been consistently maintained.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – We do not lease employees to or from other employers; all our staff are directly employed by Precision Tire and Auto Center.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Precision Tire and Auto Center carries Workers' Compensation insurance to comply with legal requirements and ensure coverage for our employees in case of work-related injuries. This policy has been active since our inception in 2020.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – We do not own or operate any other business; our focus is solely on Precision Tire and Auto Center, specializing in tire sales and basic automotive services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – We do not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. Our current policy is sufficient for our operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – At Precision Tire and Auto Center, we focus solely on tire sales and basic automotive maintenance. We are not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – We do not rent or loan equipment to others. Our operations focus exclusively on tire sales and basic automotive maintenance, minimizing any related risks.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – There have been no foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens during the past five years for Precision Tire and Auto Center.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – We do not have any significant exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals beyond the minimal use of automotive fluids, which are stored and handled according to regulatory requirements.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – We do not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused solely on tire sales and basic automotive maintenance, which do not involve high-risk activities associated with catastrophic events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring at Precision Tire and Auto Center. Our operations prioritize a safe and respectful environment for both staff and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are currently no uncorrected fire code violations at Precision Tire and Auto Center. All safety inspections and fire protection compliance measures are actively maintained.
